text: Investigators confirmed both engines had swallowed geese heavier than they were built to handle. They pushed for tougher bird tests for engines, better checklists for losing both engines down low, and more ditching training. And around New York's airports, wildlife teams now manage the geese, to keep big flocks away from the flight paths. The machines bought the time. The crew used every second of it. Would you have tried for the runway, or the river? Tell me in the comments.
